name: agents-panel
description: Band row and Agents pane showing every subagent of the session: type, model, context fill, tokens, cost, elapsed and status; the engine's own agent rows get context fill and cost too

autoOpen.title: Open the Agents pane on the first agent
autoOpen.description: Once per session, the pane opens itself when the first subagent, Bash-launched agent or Codex run starts; off, /agents-panel and the band's ×n button open it

agentRows.title: Context and cost on the built-in agent rows
agentRows.description: Puts each agent's context fill and cost in front of the words on Claude Code's own agent rows (the terminal's list under the prompt, the desktop's Background tasks); off, those rows stay as the engine draws them
